body.name: Contact-set multiplier handle
body.construction: Use the finite simplex branch values \(\widetilde f_\beta^-\) and \(\widetilde f_\beta^+\) to screen shrinking neighborhoods of the empirical optima \(\widetilde F_-(\widehat z)\) and \(\widetilde F_+(\widehat z)\), then apply Fang--Santos estimated directional derivatives and a multiplier maximum over the screened contact sets; derive the screening rate and any inflation from uniform coverage rather than fixing a candidate interval in advance.
